flags.why: Calling someone ba trợn disparages their character and needs a derogatory warning ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ba_tr%E1%BB%A3n)).
Janggi is called cờ tướng Hàn Quốc, whereas unqualified cờ tướng denotes xiangqi ([reference](https://trithuc.itrithuc.vn/articles/co-tuong-1422.html)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense; place it under cờ tướng Hàn Quốc.

flags.why: Shogi is called cờ tướng Nhật Bản, whereas unqualified cờ tướng denotes xiangqi ([reference](https://trithuc.itrithuc.vn/articles/co-tuong-1422.html)).
flags.fix: Remove this sense; place it under cờ tướng Nhật Bản.

flags.why: The example explains the historical term instead of using it to refer to someone.
flags.fix: Thím xẩm ấy bán chè ở đầu ngõ. = That Chinese woman sells sweet dessert soup at the entrance to the alley.

flags.why: Ngất ngây also occurs in everyday expressive language, so literary misleadingly restricts its use ([usage examples](https://dantri.com.vn/tim-kiem/ngon%2Bng%E1%BA%A5t%2Bng%C3%A2y.htm)).
